data.name: Fulaih
data.gender_notes: Fulaih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘falahah’ meaning rain. In Islamic tradition, rain is considered a blessing from Allah SWT. The name Fulaih is often given to boys to reflect the hope for a plentiful and beneficial rain. The name Fulaih carries the meaning “Rare Rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fulaih usually hope their child will grow to embody rare rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying the blessings of Allah SWT.
data.etymology: Fulaih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rare Rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fulaih total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فليح

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فليح مشتق من الفعل فلح، وهو يعني النجاح والفوز في الحياة والدنيا، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام آية ٧٤ 'وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ خَوْفٌ وَلَا هَمٌ'، ويدل على الشخص الذي يحقق النجاح والفلاح في مختلف المجالات، ويحمل معنى التفاؤل والخير

in_urdu.name: فضیح
in_urdu.meaning: فلاح و کامیابی کا مطلب ہے زندگی میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فضیح عربی زبان کے الفعل فلح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فلاح و کامیابی، اور یہ نام ان خوبیوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کو زندگی میں کامیاب بناتی ہیں، اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے

in_hindi.name: फलिह
